question: Explain mathematical patterns and sequences, including the rule used to generate the Fibonacci sequence and their role in recognizing structure.
urdu_translation: mathematical patterns اور sequences کی وضاحت کریں، جس میں Fibonacci sequence generate کرنے کا rule اور structure identify کرنے میں ان کا کردار شامل ہو۔

question: Define a set and compare roster, descriptive, and set-builder forms of representation with suitable textbook-supported examples.
urdu_translation: set کی تعریف کریں اور roster، descriptive اور set-builder forms of representation کا مناسب textbook-supported examples کے ساتھ موازنہ کریں۔

question: Explain empty, singleton, finite, infinite, equal, equivalent, disjoint, overlapping, subset, proper subset, and power set concepts.
urdu_translation: empty، singleton، finite، infinite، equal، equivalent، disjoint، overlapping، subset، proper subset اور power set concepts کی وضاحت کریں۔

question: Define union, intersection, difference, and complement of sets and explain their basic properties with Venn-diagram interpretation.
urdu_translation: sets کے union، intersection، difference اور complement کی تعریف کریں اور Venn-diagram interpretation کے ساتھ ان کی basic properties واضح کریں۔

question: State and verify De Morgan's two laws for sets by using element-based reasoning and Venn diagrams.
urdu_translation: sets کے لیے De Morgan's two laws بیان کریں اور element-based reasoning اور Venn diagrams سے verify کریں۔

question: Derive and explain the inclusion-exclusion principle for two sets and extend it to three finite sets.
urdu_translation: two sets کے لیے inclusion-exclusion principle اخذ اور واضح کریں اور اسے three finite sets تک extend کریں۔

question: Explain Cartesian product, binary relation, domain, and range. Show how a relation from A to B is formed as a subset of A × B.
urdu_translation: Cartesian product، binary relation، domain اور range کی وضاحت کریں۔ واضح کریں کہ A سے B تک relation، A × B کے subset کے طور پر کیسے بنتا ہے۔

question: Define a function and explain into, onto, one-one, and bijective functions with mapping conditions.
urdu_translation: function کی تعریف کریں اور mapping conditions کے ساتھ into، onto، one-one اور bijective functions کی وضاحت کریں۔

question: Compare linear and quadratic functions in terms of standard form, degree, and graphical behaviour.
urdu_translation: standard form، degree اور graphical behaviour کے لحاظ سے linear اور quadratic functions کا موازنہ کریں۔

question: Convert the following between roster and set-builder forms: (a) the set of positive even integers | (b) the set of multiples of 5 | (c) the set of natural-number squares less than 100.
urdu_translation: درج ذیل sets کو roster اور set-builder forms کے درمیان convert کریں: (a) positive even integers کا set | (b) multiples of 5 کا set | (c) 100 سے کم natural-number squares کا set

question: For A = {1,2,3}, list all subsets, identify the proper subsets, write P(A), and verify the number of elements of the power set.
urdu_translation: A = {1,2,3} کے لیے all subsets لکھیں، proper subsets identify کریں، P(A) لکھیں اور power set کے elements کی number verify کریں۔

question: Let U be the set of positive even integers less than 30, A the multiples of 6 in U, and B the multiples of 8 in U. List U, A, and B; find A ∪ B, A ∩ B, A − B, and B − A; and represent the relations by a Venn diagram.
urdu_translation: U کو 30 سے کم positive even integers کا set، A کو U میں multiples of 6 اور B کو U میں multiples of 8 لیں۔ U، A اور B لکھیں؛ A ∪ B، A ∩ B، A − B اور B − A معلوم کریں؛ اور relations کو Venn diagram سے represent کریں۔

topic: Exercise 3.2 Powers and Squares as Sets
Exercise 3.2 Powers and Squares as Sets
question: Let U={x∈Z | 0<x<150}, G={x | x=2ᵐ, m∈Z and 0<m<12}, and H={x∈U | x is a perfect square}. List G and H and determine G∪H and G∩H.
urdu_translation: درج ذیل sets G اور H لکھیں اور G∪H اور G∩H معلوم کریں: U={x∈Z | 0<x<150}, G={x | x=2ᵐ, m∈Z and 0<m<12}, H={x∈U | x is a perfect square}

question: Let P be the prime numbers between 0 and 20 and Q be the positive divisors of 210 that are less than 20. Find P ∩ Q and P ∪ Q.
urdu_translation: P کو 0 اور 20 کے درمیان prime numbers اور Q کو 20 سے کم 210 کے positive divisors کا set لیں۔ P ∩ Q اور P ∪ Q معلوم کریں۔

question: Verify the commutative properties of union and intersection for: (a) A={1,2,3,4,5}, B={4,6,8,10} | (b) N and Z | (c) A={x∈R | x>0}, B=R.
urdu_translation: درج ذیل sets کے لیے union اور intersection کی commutative properties verify کریں: (a) A={1,2,3,4,5}, B={4,6,8,10} | (b) N and Z | (c) A={x∈R | x>0}, B=R

question: Verify De Morgan's laws for U={a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j}, A={a,b,c,d,g,h}, and B={c,d,e,f,j}. Illustrate both results with Venn diagrams.
urdu_translation: درج ذیل sets کے لیے De Morgan's laws verify کریں اور دونوں results کو Venn diagrams سے illustrate کریں: U={a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j}, A={a,b,c,d,g,h}, B={c,d,e,f,j}

question: In a class of 55 students, 34 play cricket and 30 play hockey, and every student plays at least one of the two games. Find how many play both games.
urdu_translation: 55 students کی class میں 34 cricket اور 30 hockey کھیلتے ہیں اور ہر student کم از کم one game کھیلتا ہے۔ دونوں games کھیلنے والوں کی number معلوم کریں۔

question: Among 500 employees, 250 speak Urdu, 150 speak English, and 50 speak Punjabi; 40 speak Urdu and English, 30 speak English and Punjabi, and 10 speak Urdu and Punjabi. Find how many speak all three languages.
urdu_translation: 500 employees میں 250 Urdu، 150 English اور 50 Punjabi بولتے ہیں؛ 40 Urdu and English، 30 English and Punjabi اور 10 Urdu and Punjabi بولتے ہیں۔ all three languages بولنے والوں کی number معلوم کریں۔

question: A survey of 125 students gives n(C)=60, n(F)=70, n(H)=40, n(C∩F)=25, n(C∩H)=15, and n(F∩H)=10. Determine the number in all three sets and represent the complete distribution with a Venn diagram.
urdu_translation: 125 students کے survey میں n(C)=60, n(F)=70, n(H)=40, n(C∩F)=25, n(C∩H)=15 اور n(F∩H)=10 ہیں۔ all three sets میں students کی number معلوم کریں اور complete distribution کو Venn diagram سے represent کریں۔

question: In a survey of 130 customers, 57 bought garments, 50 cosmetics, and 46 electronics; 31 bought garments and cosmetics, 25 garments and electronics, 21 cosmetics and electronics, and 12 all three. Find: (a) the number buying at least one product | (b) exactly one product | (c) none.
urdu_translation: 130 customers کے survey میں 57 نے garments، 50 نے cosmetics اور 46 نے electronics خریدے؛ 31 نے garments and cosmetics، 25 نے garments and electronics، 21 نے cosmetics and electronics اور 12 نے all three خریدے۔ معلوم کریں: (a) at least one product | (b) exactly one product | (c) none کی numbers۔

question: For A = {1,2,3,4}, form the relations in A defined by: (a) y = x | (b) x + y = 5 | (c) x + y < 5 | (d) x + y > 5. State the domain and range of each relation.
urdu_translation: A = {1,2,3,4} کے لیے درج ذیل conditions سے relations بنائیں اور ہر relation کا domain و range بیان کریں: (a) y = x | (b) x + y = 5 | (c) x + y < 5 | (d) x + y > 5

question: For g(x)=3x+2 and h(x)=2x²+1, find: (a) g(0) | (b) g(−3) | (c) h(1) | (d) h(−5).
urdu_translation: درج ذیل values معلوم کریں: g(x)=3x+2, h(x)=2x²+1; (a) g(0) | (b) g(−3) | (c) h(1) | (d) h(−5)

question: Determine the constants in each function: (a) f(x)=ax+b+1, f(3)=8, f(6)=14 | (b) f(x)=cx²+d, f(1)=6, f(−2)=10.
urdu_translation: ہر function میں constants معلوم کریں: (a) f(x)=ax+b+1, f(3)=8, f(6)=14 | (b) f(x)=cx²+d, f(1)=6, f(−2)=10

question: Out of 180 students, 120 passed Mathematics, 90 passed Science, and 60 passed both. Determine the numbers who passed at least one subject, only Mathematics, only Science, and neither subject.
urdu_translation: 180 students میں 120 Mathematics، 90 Science اور 60 دونوں subjects pass ہوئے۔ at least one subject، only Mathematics، only Science اور neither subject pass کرنے والوں کی numbers معلوم کریں۔

question: Among 300 developers, n(P)=150, n(J)=130, n(H)=120, n(P∩J)=70, n(P∩H)=60, n(J∩H)=50, and n(P∩J∩H)=40. Determine the required regions, the number using at least one language, and the number using none.
urdu_translation: 300 developers کے لیے n(P)=150, n(J)=130, n(H)=120, n(P∩J)=70, n(P∩H)=60, n(J∩H)=50 اور n(P∩J∩H)=40 ہیں۔ required regions، at least one language اور none استعمال کرنے والوں کی numbers معلوم کریں۔

question: Find the unknown constants in the functions from the given values: (a) f(x)=ax+b, f(−2)=3, f(4)=10 | (b) g(x)=mx²+n, g(4)=20, g(0)=5.
urdu_translation: given values سے functions میں unknown constants معلوم کریں: (a) f(x)=ax+b, f(−2)=3, f(4)=10 | (b) g(x)=mx²+n, g(4)=20, g(0)=5
